decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be maintained in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:Existing Floor Plans (E001)Existing Front and Rear Elevation (E002)Existing Side Elevations (E003)Existing Section (E004)Proposed Floor Plans (P001)Proposed Front and Rear Elevation (P002)Proposed Side Elevation (P003)Proposed Section (P004)Proposed Site Plan (SP001)Location Plan (L001)Existing and Proposed Block Plan (EP001)Planning Statement (July 2026)SUDS PRO FORMAFlood Risk Assessment (July 2026)Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Unless otherwise specified in the application the materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted along with work of making good shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building.  Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the development respects the appearance, existing materials and built and natural features of the surrounding area.

The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 6 people at any one time and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen shall be retained in perpetuity.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

The development shall not be fully occupied until cycle parking for 6 bicycles has been provided in the front garden of the application site as required by the standards of the Council. Such facilities are to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To ensure the provision and availability of adequate cycle parking.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.

The development shall not commence until details of source control SuDS has been submitted and approved by the Local Authority. Source control SuDS measures include green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving. The details must include plans, specifications and maintenance information. The developer should use the SuDS Proforma for minor developers found on our webpage https://www.enfield.gov.uk/services/planning/sustainable-drainage-systems to assist them through our requirements.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD Policy 61,and Policies SI 12 an SI 13 of the London Plan and the NPPF and to maximise opportunities for sustainable development, improve water quality, biodiversity, local amenity and recreation value.

Prior to above ground works, the development shall not commence until details of finished floor levels be at least 150mm above the modelled surface water flood depth for a 1 in 100 year (+17% climate change) event, details of flood storage area with supporting sections, details of how the impermeable built footprint is increasing, Flood Management/Evacuation Plan and flood resistant and resilient measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development thereafter shall be implemented in strict accordance with the approved details. Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policies CP28 of the Core Strategy and DMD59, DMD60, DMD61, DMD62 of the Development Management Document.
